verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that vLLM manages KV-cache memory internally through PagedAttention, prefix caching and chunked prefill. However, nothing in the pack documents any setting that lets a power-user control how that memory is allocated or split across multiple concurrently running model instances. Automatic memory management is a related feature, not the user-controllable, multi-instance allocation the story asks for.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
